source.note: 1997 Circa Baseball hobby product. The 400-card flagship checklist and complete 400-card Rave parallel are kept intact as collector-facing VCS ProductSets. Retail-only Limited Access, dealer Promotional Sample, and administrative Emerald redemption pieces are excluded from the hobby product.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-400 is one VCS Base ProductSet. Rave #1-400 is one full parallel ProductSet so each collector checklist has one completion percentage.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Use TCDB's set-indexed rookie page as the card-level source of truth. It identifies four true RC cards: #55 Felix Heredia, #124 Tony Womack, #173 Brian Giles, and #335 Mike Holtz. Beckett reports three RCs, so the source discrepancy is documented and TCDB's linked-set records control this bundle.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus verified RC when applicable. CL, UER/ERR/COR, SN/PR, AU, EXCH and other collector annotations stay in metadata.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Insertion odds are stored only on ProductSets. No per-card Variant field receives text such as 'Inserted 1:36 packs'.
decisions.hobbyOnly: Limited Access is retail-only and excluded. The Alex Rodriguez Promotional Sample/dealer display issue is excluded because it was not an ordinary hobby-pack outcome.
decisions.emeraldAutographs: The ten Emerald Autographs Redemption pieces are administrative redemption instruments and are excluded. The six finished Emerald Autographs Exchange cards are included as the collector-facing autograph set. Their oddsPerPack remains null because the published 1:1000 rate applies to redemption pieces, not directly to one of the six finished autograph cards.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images, pricing, and any null insert odds are reviewed.

productSets.name: Icon
productSets.notes: TCDB-linked checklist contains 12 cards, inserted 1:36 packs. BaseballCardPedia lists 10; TCDB's linked checklist controls the card count for this bundle.

productSets.name: Emerald Autographs Exchange
productSets.notes: Six finished autograph cards received in exchange for the complete ten-card redemption set. AU/EXCH metadata is retained. The 1:1000 hobby rate applies to redemption pieces and is not assigned directly to these finished cards.
